title: Install and operate EMT
summary: Install matched EMT program and provider bytes, configure paused state, and operate its worker and owned maintenance without silently approving a failure halt.
use_when: The current user must install matched EMT bytes, configure or activate its worker, inspect readiness or inspect a failed installation instruction.
do_not_use_when: The user needs another recipient, sender authentication, continuous repair, or a replacement for product-owned recovery.
outcome: An explicitly configured or maintained EMT installation with separate schedule, pause and failure-halt state.
effects: Agent work can inspect and operate current-user Cell systems and send incident email under the authorized exchange. Configuration, scheduling, maintenance and installation have their documented separate effects.

The declared deploy instruction resolves a missing receiving domain through Email, initializes or migrates local state, saves configuration, configures the EMT route and publishes the exact worker definition with intended enabled state. It creates no maintenance hold or migration receipt and drains no exchanges. It preserves absence, disabled intent, operator pause and failure halts unless a supported setup option changes operator intent.
authority: EMT owns its configuration, admission, state, maintenance holds and installation. Clockwork owns scheduling and exact failure-halt continuation; Nucleus owns jobs; Email owns transport and credentials.
success: Complete program and state setup, known maintenance counts and preserved or requested schedule, pause and halt intent. Installation does not establish readiness. Interpret Email acceptance and domain success separately.
failure_and_recovery: Stop on missing authority or failed setup. Installation failure leaves prior effects in place; inspect them before an explicit next operation. No automatic repeat, rollback or recovery occurs. Explicit maintenance requires known drain and exact hold ownership. Preserve uncertain exchanges and mail identities; initialized direct selector recovery is unsupported.
privacy: Correspondence and pointers remain private and retained. Nucleus and email providers keep separate copies. Logs and ordinary status omit bodies.
does_not_authorize: Unrequested recipients, unrelated mutations, automatic failed-job replacement, or clearing a newer Clockwork halt.

consumers.statement: The current user and authorized EMT installation, activation or maintenance operator.

preconditions.statement: The chosen installation or operational effect is authorized and setup paths and receiving domain are supplied or resolvable. Manual configuration and migration commands retain their paused and drained prerequisites. The deploy instruction uses ordinary product admission and runner locks, without acquiring maintenance holds or checking application health.
New preparation requires initialized Bazaar state and a complete cell.prompts.emt selection; seed import and historical version preservation precede deployment, which supplies no missing content.

inputs.statement: Matched absolute program/provider paths, selected current configuration, explicit schedule and pause intent, exact maintenance owner, and captured configuration.

outputs.statement: Program/provider selection and setup effects, instruction exit status and log, and preserved or explicitly selected activation intent. Doctor observations and maintenance drain evidence belong to separately invoked product commands.

data_semantics.statement: Installation, initialization, configuration, admission and scheduling are separate effects. Counts describe retained records. Unknown outstanding counts cannot satisfy drain; installation or resume does not approve an exact Clockwork halt.

identity_and_units.statement: emt/worker selects the exact Clockwork binding; OWNER identifies an explicit maintenance hold; INCIDENT_ID selects exact halt continuation. The executor identifies each instruction and its retained log.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Installation performs setup without artifact-integrity, state-integrity or operational-readiness checks. Ordinary doctor observations remain separate; receiving permission and final delivery remain not_probed by doctor.
No timer latency, model accuracy, final-delivery deadline, future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

access.statement: Procedures operate current-user private state. Activation requires account-read, investigation and mail authority, with unrestricted current-user agent execution and deferred sender verification. Explicit reads can expose correspondence.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The declared deploy instruction publishes matched bytes, initializes or migrates local state, saves configuration and publishes an exact worker definition under ordinary admission and runner locks. It neither suspends scheduling nor holds or drains exchanges.

Fresh deployment activates after configuration unless explicit paused/enabled settings override. An existing absent binding stays absent unless activation is requested. Interrupted instructions are not repeated or recovered automatically; direct initialized selector recovery is unsupported.

operational_limits.statement: Only schema-one migration is supported. Configuration changes require paused drained work. Migration retains product and provider histories. Required features retain worker, assignment and transport bounds.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: The procedure retains its stable operation identity and version while required feature contracts provide detailed compatible behavior. Matched program, installer and bundle travel with the release.
No future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

reliances.statement: Incident authority, deadlines, exact identities and recovery are owned by the EMT incident feature.
EMT service state, readiness, maintenance, matched installation and recovery are owned by the service feature.
Quota deferral and frozen notice delivery preserve their independent recovery rules.
Receiving domain discovery uses the supported Email account-settings interface.
Prompt readiness depends on Bazaar shared selection format and preparation over exact immutable text versions; EMT owns authored meaning, selected components and execution policy.

steps: Establish authority, dependencies, prompt selection, receiving domain and stable paths before maintenance or activation.
Install matched bytes before initialization, or execute the declared manifest instruction for initialized updates.
Initialize paused state, configure drained work, inspect doctor, then resume and enable only authorized intent.
Inspect separate pause, schedule, holds and exact halt evidence; approve exact failure-halt continuation separately.
Use an exact owner and known drained work for separately requested manual maintenance; preserve private state before release.
Inspect instruction exit status and log. Inspect completed effects after failure or interruption before an explicit next operation.
checkpoints: The selected EMT binary and provider versions match.
Configuration, operator pause, schedule enablement and failure halts remain separate.
Drained migration preserves correspondence and Nucleus references.
adaptation: Install missing compatible dependencies before enabling EMT.
Preserve existing pauses, disabled bindings and other maintenance owners.
stop_when: Ownership or drained state is unknown, or a setup operation fails.
An initialized update attempts direct selector recovery.
